stalls.en: Er Shi Xiong Old-Style Braised Snacks
stalls.where: 海安路三段533號（第3排一帶）
stalls.summaryZh: 花園夜市最常被點名的滷味，滷汁偏鹹甜、帶點三杯香，滷得很入味；排隊人多但動得快。
stalls.summaryEn: The most-mentioned stall at Garden: sweet-savory braise with a hint of three-cup flavor, deeply soaked. Lines are long but move fast.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜8大台南夜市精選：營業時間表、必吃美食攻略
兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 1999年開業的人氣攤，可選椰奶、紅咖哩等湯底，網友最推椰香紅咖哩牛肉；椰香濃、辣度溫和，座位常客滿。
stalls.summaryEn: Running since 1999 with several broths; the coconut red curry beef is the top pick. Rich coconut, gentle heat, and seats are almost always full.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食
蕃薯藤旅遊｜台南夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 先炸後烤刷秘製醬，醬香重、肉仍多汁，尖峰時段大排長龍；有人覺得醬偏甜、粉皮稍厚。
stalls.summaryEn: Fried then charcoal-grilled with a house glaze; saucy yet juicy, with big peak-hour lines. Some find it sweet with a thickish coating.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜8大台南夜市精選：營業時間表、必吃美食攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 糖衣脆、地瓜鬆軟香甜，近年人氣上升需要排隊，常被列為飯後甜點。
stalls.summaryEn: A crackly sugar shell over soft, sweet potato; increasingly popular, so expect a wait. A go-to dessert stop.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 老牌蚵仔煎攤，有座位，外皮煎得焦香、內層軟嫩；但有2025年遊記表示一時沒找到攤位，建議現場確認。
stalls.summaryEn: A long-running oyster omelette stall with seating; crisp edges, soft center. One 2025 visitor could not find it, so confirm on site.

stalls.summaryZh: 需要排隊的煎餃攤，內餡飽滿紮實，特製醬汁偏鹹，可依口味斟酌。
stalls.summaryEn: A queue-worthy dumpling stall with generous, firm fillings; the house sauce leans salty.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 現烤胡椒餅外皮酥脆、蔥香明顯、肉汁多，胡椒味輕重評價不一。
stalls.summaryEn: Baked-to-order pepper buns with a crisp crust, lots of scallion and juicy filling; opinions vary on how peppery it is.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 現蒸現拌的玉米杯，口味多、起司味濃，好邊走邊吃，親子客喜歡。
stalls.summaryEn: Freshly steamed corn cups in many flavors with plenty of cheese; easy to eat while walking and popular with families.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 可以跟老闆玩彈珠台賭香腸，娛樂性大於美食，但香腸肥瘦適中也不差。
stalls.summaryEn: Play a marble game with the owner to win sausages; more about the fun than the food, though the sausage itself is decent.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南花園夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 1993年起的麻糬攤，口味很多可任選組合，口感軟Q不黏牙，適合當伴手禮或甜點。
stalls.summaryEn: A mochi stall dating to 1993 with many mix-and-match flavors; soft and chewy without sticking. Good as dessert or a takeaway gift.
